stories.title: Lil Durk found not guilty, and fans swarm his lawyer
stories.summary: Lil Durk was found not guilty on all counts in his murder-for-hire trial. Fans mobbed his lawyer Brian Steel, who also represented Young Thug, as he left the courthouse. The clip got 103K likes, and its top quote post, "now the safest man in chicago", got 272K.
